events.text: Goal! Manchester United 1, Sabah 0. Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) right footed shot from very close range to the top left corner. Assisted by Patrick Dorgu with a cross.
Goal! Manchester United 2, Sabah 0. Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Youri Tielemans.
Goal! Manchester United 3, Sabah 0. Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Bryan Mbeumo with a through ball.
First Half ends, Manchester United 3, Sabah 0.
Substitution, Manchester United. Mason Mount replaces Youri Tielemans.
Substitution, Sabah. Orphé Mbina replaces Christian Nwachukwu.
Second Half begins Manchester United 3, Sabah 0.
Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Sabah. Aleksey Isayev replaces Kaheem Parris.
Substitution, Manchester United. Joshua Zirkzee replaces Benjamin Sesko.
Substitution, Manchester United. Andrey Santos replaces Kobbie Mainoo.
Ivan Lepinjica (Sabah) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Manchester United 4, Sabah 0. Lisandro Martínez (Manchester United) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner following a set piece situation.
Substitution, Sabah. Abdulla Xaybulayev replaces Umarali Rakhmonaliev.
Substitution, Manchester United. Shea Lacey replaces Bryan Mbeumo.
Substitution, Manchester United. Harry Amass replaces Patrick Dorgu.
Substitution, Sabah. Du Queiroz replaces Veljko Simic.
Substitution, Sabah. Júnior Almeida replaces Akim Zedadka.
